accountTable.selfPasswordHint: Change your own password under Settings -> Account & Security
accountTable.disableDesc: Once disabled, {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in. Existing profiles and records will be retained. Confirm?

employeesList.heading: Employees
employeesList.appealsHint: Showing only employees on the current page with open disputes; paginate to see more.

unlinkedAccounts.intro: These accounts are not linked to an employee profile and only support viewing roles.

issueAccounts.title: Issue Accounts
issueAccounts.description: Create login accounts for selected employees and download a spreadsheet containing initial passwords.
issueAccounts.issuedHint: The account spreadsheet can only be downloaded once and contains initial passwords. Share them privately with each employee (password change required on first login).
issueAccounts.rangeError: Failed to load eligible employee count.
issueAccounts.countSummary: Will issue accounts for {{count}} active employee(s) without an account
issueAccounts.allIssued: All active employees already have accounts.
issueAccounts.regenerateLabel: Reset initial password for "Pending First Login" accounts (old passwords will become invalid)
issueAccounts.regenerateHint: Check this option to regenerate passwords, or deselect these employees
issueAccounts.conflictNotice: Conflicts found for the following employees. No accounts were issued; please resolve and retry:

resetPassword.title: Reset Password · {{name}}
resetPassword.descAfter: The new password is shown only once. Share it privately with the employee; you cannot view it again after closing.
resetPassword.descBefore: Resetting immediately invalidates the old password. The employee must sign in with the new password and set a new one.

roleGrant.alreadyGranted: This role has already been granted
roleGrant.title: Grant Role
roleGrant.description: Only active employees with active accounts can be granted roles.
roleGrant.limitNotice: Showing the first 100 employees; search by name or ID to narrow results.

personnel.descOffboard: Confirming will deactivate the employee and account while retaining their profile and evidence.
personnel.descDefault: Separate multi-level departments with / (e.g. Engineering/Frontend). Preview changes before saving.

summary.employeeConfirmTentative: Published as tentative after employee confirmation

approvalPolicy.historyOrgLine: Org-wide: Manager approval {{required}}; Confirmation window: {{days}} days
approvalPolicy.defaultTipContent: New rules apply to future requests. Without manager approval, employee-confirmed changes publish as tentative. No-approval only applies to categories selected below and is off by default for new categories.
approvalPolicy.requireManagerHint: When disabled, employee-confirmed changes publish directly as tentative. Admin batch handovers still require manager approval.
approvalPolicy.ownerReviewDaysTipContent: Set 1–90 days. Overdue unconfirmed initial profiles can be batch-submitted for review by an admin.
approvalPolicy.categoryTipContent: Override the approval rule for specific capability categories. Unconfigured categories inherit the default rule above.
approvalPolicy.categoryDescription: "No approval (Pi drafts auto-published)" applies only to selected categories and is off by default for new categories; others follow the default rule above.
approvalPolicy.noCategories: No capability categories in the current dictionary; the default manager approval rule applies.
approvalPolicy.selectOptional: No manager approval (publish on employee confirm)

updateSettings.savedMessage: Reminder settings saved; evidence expiration takes effect immediately.
updateSettings.tipContent: Periodically reminds employees in their inbox to review recent updates. Stale evidence only prompts a review without changing levels.

timezone.label: Organization Timezone
timezone.tipContent: Used for notification timestamps, work record imports, and daily 09:00 admin digest delivery.

disputes.heading: Appeals & Disputes
disputes.description: Resolving an appeal does not edit the profile directly; if reopened, the employee's revised submission still goes through normal review.
disputes.ownAppealNotice: You cannot resolve your own appeal; another organization administrator must handle it

modelPage.heading: Models
modelPage.statusError: Unable to load status right now.

draftingPage.title: Auto-Drafting
draftingPage.description: When enabled, each work record sync automatically drafts or updates profiles (consumes model quota).
draftingPage.modelDisabledNotice: No model is enabled. Enable a model under Model Configuration first.
draftingPage.confirmRedraft: This will only overwrite drafts not yet confirmed by employees; published profiles are unaffected. Confirm re-drafting?

draftingNote.label: Drafting Supplement Note
draftingNote.description: Add organization ticket and business context notes (does not alter permissions or drafting rules; save empty to disable).

botPage.heading: Built-in Assistant
botPage.questionGuidePlaceholder: e.g. Ask about cross-department collaboration on specific projects.
botPage.questionGuideHint: Takes effect from the next conversation turn; does not alter identity, permissions, or confirmation rules.
botPage.retentionHint: Default is 0 days (cleared after 2 hours of inactivity), configurable 1–30 days. Messages are stored encrypted; cleanup does not affect confirmed submissions.
botPage.modelDisabledHint: Model is not enabled yet. Employees can still edit their profiles directly.
botPage.chatgptQuotaHint: The organization shares this ChatGPT subscription's 5-hour and weekly quota (drafting tasks take priority).
botPage.rateLimitHint: Limit: 30 conversation turns per employee per hour.

feishu.name: Feishu
feishu.description: Use the built-in assistant in Feishu direct messages to update profiles.

wecom.name: WeCom
wecom.description: Connect the built-in assistant via a WeCom custom app persistent connection.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Connect the built-in assistant via a bot token for employees on Telegram.

imPage.heading: IM Channels
imPage.intro: After binding their chat account, employees can update their profile on supported platforms.
imPage.credentialsHelp: Obtain credentials from your chat platform's app admin console. Stored encrypted; leave blank to keep unchanged.
imPage.autoBindHelp: When enabled, a chat account whose work email uniquely matches an active employee binds automatically without a bind code.
imPage.wecomNote: Use WeCom persistent connection mode (no public callback URL needed). Only one service instance is allowed per app. If work email cannot be read, use a bind code from web Settings; newly created apps usually cannot read emails. When enabled, testing reads the latest heartbeat without opening another connection.
imPage.dataTransferBody: Messages sent via IM are stored on the platform provider's servers.
imPage.telegramLocationNote: Servers are located outside mainland China and may not be directly reachable from domestic networks.
imPage.acknowledgeLabel: I acknowledge the data transfer notice

assistantsPage.heading: External AI Tools
assistantsPage.dataWarning: When enabled, employees' profiles, evidence, and self-reports may be sent to external assistant providers. Confirm your organization permits external transfer of this data.
assistantsPage.cardDesc: Employees can authorize external tools via MCP to access their own data, strictly within their own permissions.
assistantsPage.allowedClientsPlaceholder: Comma-separated names; leave blank for all
assistantsPage.allowedClientsHelp: Matched by client-reported name; not a security boundary as names can be spoofed.
assistantsPage.acknowledgeCheckbox: I confirm the organization permits sending profiles, evidence, and self-reports to external tools

modelForm.enabledHint: When enabled, powers auto-drafting and AI assistants. Profiles can still be maintained manually when off.
modelForm.billingHint: Cloud APIs are billed by the provider; subscription mode shares the connected account's quota.
modelForm.modelNamePlaceholder: Enter the model ID from your provider
modelForm.testHint: Save and click "Test Connection" to verify.
modelForm.chatgptPrefixHint: Keep the chatgpt/ prefix; available models depend on the connected account's subscription.
modelForm.reasoningHint: Higher effort takes longer and uses more quota; default is usually best.
modelForm.providerKeyHint: API key must match the selected provider.
modelForm.claudeNote: Claude requires an Anthropic API key; Claude subscriptions cannot be used for login.
modelForm.baseUrlHelp: API Base URL provided by your service, not a chat web page URL.
modelForm.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved; leave blank to keep unchanged
modelForm.apiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted; leave blank to keep the existing key unchanged.
modelForm.clearKeyHelp: Checking and saving removes the saved key; you will need to re-enter one to connect.
modelForm.privacyNote: Privacy notice: Only the capability dictionary and de-identified work records are sent; employee names, IDs, and emails are excluded.

chatGpt.disconnectNote: Disconnecting does not revoke the token on OpenAI's side; sign out of this session in ChatGPT security settings to revoke immediately.
chatGpt.pendingInstructions: Open the authorization link and sign in, then paste the final full redirect URL below. Seeing an unreachable localhost page is expected.
chatGpt.expiredNotice: Authorization link expired; please start again.
chatGpt.note1: Connects via a ChatGPT subscription subject to 5-hour and weekly usage limits shared across the organization (auto-pauses and resumes when limits reset).
chatGpt.note2: For personal Plus/Pro accounts, disable model training under ChatGPT Data Controls.
chatGpt.note3: For production enterprise data, consider a Business/Enterprise workspace or an API key.

draftProgress.heading: Initial Profile Drafting Progress
draftProgress.autoDraftDisabled: Auto-drafting is off. Enable it under Settings -> Models first.
draftProgress.noModelNotice: No AI model configured yet. Configure one under Settings -> Models, or have employees maintain profiles manually/via import.
draftProgress.noContentHint: No content includes employees with no external work records or records without sufficient evidence for an assessment.
draftProgress.noContentJiraHint: To include Jira issue descriptions, enable "Sync issue descriptions" under Data Sources and re-sync.
draftProgress.excludedCount: {{count}} employee(s) opted out of auto-drafting (editable in their personal settings).
draftProgress.confirmRedraft: This will only overwrite drafts not yet confirmed by employees; published profiles are unaffected. Confirm re-drafting?
draftProgress.handoverCount: Unconfirmed past {{days}} days (ready for batch review): {{count}}
draftProgress.handoverNote: Marks profiles as "Employee Unconfirmed", notifies employees, and allows withdrawal before approval.
draftProgress.confirmHandover: Submit initial profiles for {{count}} unconfirmed employee(s) for manager review?

coverage.heading: Profile Coverage
coverage.tipContent: Unassessed does not mean lacking a capability. Click a status to filter active employees; click again to clear.
coverage.unassignedNote: Employees without a department are included in the total.
